_about: The journey map on the CRM's Pipeline page (Jonathan, 2026-10-01). One node per acquisition channel, top of the funnel first, in his order. sources: the CRM channels (Source.Name) and, with pick, which of their campaigns belong here (a regular expression on the campaign name). A node is in color when one of those campaigns is Live. tasks: what it takes to get the channel running (the card ticks them here). artifacts: what the channel needs to work, shown in the card's deeper view; kind files lists paths or globs from the repo root (path#Heading shows one section), the other kinds are read by scripts/crm_server.py. Edited by hand or by the AIOS; the CRM writes only the done flags.

tasks.text: Billing fixed on the Ads account.
A test booking reached Airtable with Google's tags.
Remove the /book page view as a conversion in Google Ads (Goals, Summary, click it, Remove). The last gate before Go live.
Press Go live on 07 AV marketing (Channels, Google Ads, open 07). It is built and paused at $30 a day.
Say go to publish 01, 02, 04, 05, and 06 (built paused, one test slot at a time).
Upload the matched company list to Campaign Manager.
Write the ad copy.
Set the budget and start the campaign.

nodes.label: Cold email
produce: Booked 15-minute calls from cold email to integrators and electricians.

tasks.text: Write the cold email copy: the first email and two follow-ups. None is written yet; you see the drafts first.
Pick the list: the integrators with an owner name and an email (the strong Meta customer list).
Send from a separate domain and inbox, warmed up first, so jonathan@monarcbuild.com stays clean.
Get the business name, address, and phone listed the same way across the directories (NAP citations, on Channels, Google Organic).
Wire Patrick's sheet into the CRM, so his connects, replies, and bookings count here. Patrick runs the messages and logs them in a sheet today.

nodes.label: Cold calling
produce: The daily quota: every weekday's dials, met.
The second window (2026-10-03): the free search check and campaign file, a Google review after each, 12 to 15 reviews in two weeks (projects/free-campaign/README.md).

tasks.text: Approve the second-window call script (references/free-campaign-call-script.md) and the two emails (templates/free-campaign-delivery-email.md, free-campaign-review-ask.md).
Open the DataForSEO account ($50) and put DATAFORSEO_LOGIN and DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD in secrets.env, so the audit reads the real Google page.
Log the second window's calls in the Prospects table "Free campaign calls": pick the company, type the outcome, the email. A yes builds the delivery.
Build every yes (python scripts/free_campaign.py queue), draft the delivery and, two days after it is sent, the review ask; read the Sent folder back.
Approve the first three deliveries in the CRM (the row's Stage to Approved), then send each draft from Proton.

artifacts.title: The second window: the free-campaign call, the plan, the two emails

nodes.label: YouTube ads
produce: Booked 15-minute calls from trades watching the channels and searches we pick.

tasks.text: Find the YouTube channels and the keyword phrases to advertise on.
Write the ad copy for the video.
Write the video script.
Record the video.
Build the campaign in Google Ads (YouTube runs there) and start it.

nodes.label: Meta ads
produce: Booked 15-minute calls from AV integrators who finish the builder search check on /builder-check/ (plan 2026-10-03, projects/meta-ads/README.md).

tasks.text: Create the Meta accounts: Business Manager, the ad account with a payment method, the Page "Monarc Build" (butterfly profile photo), a linked Instagram, the Pixel. Send the AIOS the Pixel id and the ad account id.
Approve the three scripts (projects/meta-ads/scripts.md) and confirm the Georgian proof span.
Record three takes of each script: 4K vertical, a good mic, any room, each under 30 seconds, into media/inbox.
Higgsfield Ad Multiplier pass: the rack room and his wardrobe, every run quoted, 800 credits at most, frame QA, the raw take kept.
Cut, caption, and export the three ads in Monarc Studio.
Build /builder-check/ from projects/meta-ads/check.md once its style tile is approved; the Pixel on every page; the privacy lines; fbclid in the popup.
Approve the privacy lines and say go to push; republish the booking script, or move it and the calendar to jonathan@monarcbuild.com (tasks.md, Booker journey).
Approve and post the three Page posts (projects/meta-ads/page-posts.md). The ad waits a week of Page age.
A test booking on /builder-check/ with the Meta labels reaches Airtable; Events Manager shows Lead and Schedule; the campaign is built paused with its id in the row's Platform id.
Go live Tue 2026-10-20 at $30 a day. Read at $500 (about Nov 5). Stop at $1,000 unless one qualified booking was held.

artifacts.title: The builder search check (the page and the popup)
Customer list, round two (the lookalike seed)

nodes.label: Organic social
produce: Status: proof you are on the phones every day. The cold call videos go here, and every other channel points to it.

tasks.text: Pick where the cold call videos go: LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube Shorts, TikTok.
Post the finished shorts from Monarc Studio (media/ready) through the scheduler.
Point every channel at it: the profile link in the email signature, the site footer, and the ads.

Second input (2026-10-05): the Loom website reviews, cut into shorts by the Content Repurposer (before, the changes, the after). The tool is OpusClip (references/opusclip.md). Make the account, start Pro or its trial, and sign in through /mcp; then one review runs as the test.
